entities.name: David E. Lilienthal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Eli Lilienthal was an American attorney and public administrator, best known for his presidential appointment to head Tennessee Valley Authority and later the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC). He had practiced public utility law and led the Wisconsin Public Utilities Commission.
